fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Register the browser tool, letting the agent drive a Chromium browser over CDP.

fields.label: Observation Mode
fields.description: What browser state is injected into context each turn: an annotated screenshot, the interactive-element accessibility tree (role + name + states, referenced by element_id), or both.

fields.label: Highlight elements
fields.description: After each element scan, flash labeled bounding boxes over the interactive elements in the live page for 5 seconds (never visible in the agent's screenshots).

fields.label: Headless
fields.description: Launch Chromium without a visible window. Ignored when attaching to an existing browser via CDP URL.

fields.label: CDP URL or port
fields.description: Attach to an already-running Chrome instead of launching one. Accepts a ws:// URL, an http://host:port endpoint, or a bare debug port like 9222. Leave empty to launch a browser owned by the agent.

fields.label: Persistent profile directory
fields.description: Reuse a persistent Chrome profile dir across runs instead of a throwaway one. Sign into sites (e.g. Google) once as a human in this profile and the agent stays logged in. Leave empty for an ephemeral profile.

fields.label: Stealth
fields.description: Inject anti-detection fingerprint patches (hides navigator.webdriver, etc.). Helps with basic bot checks; does not defeat Google's sign-in block on its own.
